emergence.summary: An X-linked single-gene F8 loss-of-function lowers coagulation factor VIII, the non-enzymatic COFACTOR that, once activated (FVIIIa), partners activated factor IX (FIXa) in the intrinsic tenase to activate factor X. Without functional factor VIII the intrinsic-tenase step is crippled, thrombin/fibrin generation is under-driven and haemostasis fails -> spontaneous and trauma-related bleeding (haemarthroses, soft-tissue and other bleeds), severity tracking residual factor VIII -> the coagulation-cascade axis is driven DOWN. This COMPLETES the coagulation A/B pair with haemophilia B (F9): the SAME haemostasis axis broken one component over -- F8 is the cofactor, F9 the protease of the same intrinsic-tenase step (so both are read as lost ACCELERATORS of the cascade -> axis DOWN). Read as a lost ACCELERATOR (factor VIII drives clot formation as FIXa's cofactor; LOF -> under-driven haemostasis), the deficiency-driven DOWN shape. The kit re-derives the corrective direction with a NEW LEVER CLASS not previously in the kit -- the cofactor MIMIC: emicizumab, a bispecific antibody that bridges FIXa and factor X, performing factor VIIIa's bridging FUNCTION WITHOUT being factor VIII (so it works even in people who have developed neutralising anti-FVIII inhibitors). This is distinct from 'replace' (supplying the same molecule) and from 'correct' (rescuing the native protein): the corrective molecule is a DIFFERENT entity doing the missing element's job. The established direction-consistent arms are also re-derived: factor VIII protein replacement (recombinant / plasma-derived, including extended-half-life fusions) and valoctocogene roxaparvovec, an AAV F8 gene-transfer therapy that restores endogenous factor VIII (the first approved haemophilia A gene therapy). The gamma read is of the F8 locus switch STRUCTURE (an AT-leaning Xq28 promoter, sitting above its haemophilia-B partner F9 in gamma); the disease lesion is coding/structural -- most commonly the intron-22 inversion that disrupts the F8 ORF, plus missense/nonsense -- outside the structural promoter-window read. X-linked, so penetrance/severity are zygosity-dependent (males hemizygous; carrier females variable by X-inactivation) and held [O]. Magnitude [O].
emergence.emergent_axis: coagulation-cascade output (factor-VIIIa-cofactored intrinsic-tenase / thrombin-fibrin generation) -- the same haemostasis axis as haemophilia B, broken at the cofactor instead of the protease

per_gene.note: F8 encodes coagulation factor VIII, a large non-enzymatic cofactor; activated FVIIIa is a positive DRIVER of the coagulation cascade -- it is the obligatory cofactor for FIXa in the intrinsic tenase that activates factor X. As an ACCELERATOR of clot formation, its LOF LOSES the drive -> thrombin/fibrin generation under-driven -> bleeding. The promoter gamma reads the locus switch STRUCTURE only; it does NOT encode the coding lesion (firewall). The pathological axis is the COAGULATION OUTPUT (it goes DOWN), so the corrective levers RAISE it. Xq28 (OMIM 300841). NCBI official symbol F8. X-linked recessive. The commonest severe lesion is the intron-22 inversion (plus intron-1 inversion, missense, nonsense), all outside the promoter window.

falsifiers.claim: F8 LOF lowers coagulation-cascade output (haemostasis under-driven)
falsifiers.falsifier: an F8 LOF allele that RAISED thrombin generation / shortened clotting time or improved haemostasis would refute the drive-down direction
falsifiers.measurable_by: plasma factor VIII activity and thrombin-generation / aPTT clotting assay stratified by F8 genotype

falsifiers.claim: restoring the cofactor FUNCTION -- by mimic (emicizumab) or by replacing factor VIII -- is the CORRECTIVE direction
falsifiers.falsifier: if bridging FIXa/FX with a mimetic, or raising factor VIII, REDUCED coagulation output or WORSENED bleeding, the mimic/replace lever sign is wrong
falsifiers.measurable_by: thrombin generation / bleed-rate response to emicizumab or to factor VIII restoration

falsifiers.claim: the cofactor mimic acts WITHOUT being factor VIII (works past anti-FVIII inhibitors)
falsifiers.falsifier: if emicizumab's haemostatic effect required endogenous/infused factor VIII or were neutralised by anti-FVIII inhibitors, the 'mimic, not replace' distinction would be refuted
falsifiers.measurable_by: bleed protection on emicizumab in inhibitor-positive vs inhibitor-negative people

gate_falsifiers.gate: falsifier register (>=1 measurable falsifier per disease)
